title: Concurrent isolated workers race in git worktree add
observed: In CI (run 43257491916, qa-headless xterm-light 3/3) the second isolated worker failed to start: git worktree add --detach ... exit status 128: fatal: failed to read .git/worktrees/worktree/commondir: Success. The batch was not integrated and WAITFOR /integrated 2 patches/ timed out.
expected: Every isolated worker in a batch gets its worktree; concurrent git worktree add/remove calls never read each other's half-written admin directory.
